高考英语3500词 · 09英文原文

Wildlife Protection

保护野生动植物 · 161 词 · 3 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1Dinosaurs died out because of an unexpected incident. But wildlife today is disappearing or is under threat because of the harm people cause. For example, tigers are hunted for their fur, which is used to make carpets, so they are safest in secure reserves. Grasslands are destroyed without mercy, giving rise to dust storms that affect distant cities.

2Last year, scientists saw some monkeys rubbing themselves with a certain kind of insect to protect themselves from the bites of fierce mosquitoes. Tests showed that the insect contained a powerful drug, so local farmers were employed to catch the insects. As a result, the insects disappeared from the entire zone. When told that it was a loss to humans, the farmers burst into laughter and responded, “Our real loss is our decreasing income.”

3We should appreciate the balance of nature and pay more attention to wildlife protection. Not until we succeed in letting wildlife live in peace can we smile in relief.

高考英语3500词 · 09中文译文

保护野生动植物

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1恐龙因为一次意外事件而灭绝。如今，野生动植物之所以消失或受到威胁，却是因为人类的破坏。例如，有人为了取得做地毯的虎皮而猎杀老虎，因此老虎待在自然保护区里最安全。草原也遭到无情破坏，沙尘暴随之形成，影响到遥远的城市。

2去年，科学家看到一些猴子把某种昆虫在身上擦，以免被凶猛的蚊子叮咬。检验结果表明，这种昆虫含有一种药效很强的物质。于是，人们雇了当地农民来捕捉这些昆虫，结果把整个地区的昆虫都抓没了。有人说这是人类的损失，农民却放声大笑，答道：“我们收入少了，那才是真正的损失。”

3我们应该珍惜自然的平衡，更加重视保护野生动植物。等到我们真的能让它们安稳地生活，才可以放心地笑一笑。
